dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh? Look who it is.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #To what do I owe the honor? Or did you just need my help, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you finding this place?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Not bad. The courtyard furnishings are very nice, and the scenery in the distance is really one of a kind.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: So yeah, I think I'm gonna enjoy my time off here.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: In my own home, of course.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: My home's located some way outside of the city, in a very quiet and peaceful area.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hehe... judging by the look on your face, I'm guessing you've fallen for the rumors about me being very wealthy and having high demands for my standards of living?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Seeing isn't always believing, and if you can't trust your eyes, you certainly can't trust rumors.

choices.text: Being away from the hustle and bustle has its benefits...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Bingo. I think you got it. Seems like you're learning.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If you live far enough out in the sticks, you have plenty of legitimate reasons to ditch work. The mountain path was blocked, or you ran into some Treasure Hoarders en route...

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Not to mention that if you live in a packed and bustling city, it's much easier for people to trace your steps. This creates all kinds of issues, and gets in the way of my ability to track my targets.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Interesting, I hadn't considered that.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: That said, since I'm free to come and go as I please here, it would be a terrible waste for me to not use it as a backup base.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You wouldn't mind that, would you?

choices.text: Perhaps it helps with your work...
Where do you usually spend your down time?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I would be delighted.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We should make some tea, too. Sipping tea, chatting, and just enjoying the time off, it's a great way to recharge.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hey, you're friendly with "Rain Calmer," aren't you? I hear she's a tea drinker, too. Why don't you treat me to some choice tea from her personal collection?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Heh, I'm just pulling your leg. She let me try some of her tea already, and we had a lovely chat.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The key to making sure a conversation goes well is choosing the right topic.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: For chatting with you... let's go with tracking techniques, ambush essentials, expanding your network of contacts, and setting up lookouts.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hehe. Well, if you were just looking to shoot the breeze with me, I can get on board with that, too.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: You know me — role-playing's one of my biggest strengths.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: ...Seriously, though, I think the topics I mentioned are the ones really worth sharing with you.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: The things I've learned come from a mix of secret techniques taught by the Millelith Scouts, real-life cases of competition in the business world, and the experience of various overseas organizations.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: For someone like you, this knowledge is going to come in handy sooner or later.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Once you've mastered it, you'll be able to avoid being pushed around by those in the know.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Anyway, just remember to come to me if you ever want to improve in these areas. I'll teach you everything I know.

choices.text: You should go earn her trust yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Isn't this your time off? You should do something that isn't too mentally taxing.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh, I have some dice in my pocket. Why don't we have a little fun?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll roll the dice, and the score decides who confesses.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If I roll a one, three, or five, you have to confess. You have to tell me... a secret that no one else can ever be allowed to know.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: If it's two, four, or six, then I'll be the one who has to reveal an important secret to you. What do you say?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: In other words, you still have some reservations towards me.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: But the good news is, you passed the test. The fact that you'll keep some cards close to your chest even in front of a major ally actually makes me more confident in you.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Maybe you'll make a successful intelligence agent yourself one day. I'm excited to go up against you.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Oh? So you really want to play, despite there being a fifty-fifty chance of losing?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Or is it that you're willing to take a gamble for the sake of finding out my secrets?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Interesting. I was going to pull a little trick, but now even I'm looking forward to this.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Hehe... Then let round one begin.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Morning... this is early for me, but you seem pretty peppy.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You don't seem to have much going on right now, though, so I think I'll go ahead and snooze a while longer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Yelan.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #Good night to you too, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll keep working for a little while longer. My mind's at peak efficiency at this hour, so it's the perfect time to go through the clues and piece everything together...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This house is similar to a place in Southwest Minlin that I lived in for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Minlin... now that was a smooth operation. Thinking back on it puts me in a good mood.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I should go back and give that place a spring-clean sometime. Never know when it might prove useful again...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This food street is great. It really captures that urban feel of Chihu Rock.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: You've got to have a proper breakfast to get yourself in the right mood for work.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Also — if you keep an ear open when you're at one of these roadside eateries, you can usually pick up a few useful snippets of information...
